30.text: WEREGILD. — Weregild may be accepted either for murder, or, much

31.text: more frequently, for any lesser crime perpetrated on person or property. The

32.text: Chukchee language has several expressions for weregild. One of these is

33.text: qäl-vil (literally, “misfortune-value”). This term is applied to weregild for

34.text: more serious crimes; i. e., for murder and for great robberies.

35.text: Puˊurɪn (literally, “exchange”) is applied to cases of minor robberies and

36.text: of corporal damages not followed by death. The same stem, however, is also

37.text: used for all kinds of retributions, even for blood-revenge. Puurɪˊtkulɪn (“the

39.text: mentioned before. Kɪˊtkau (literally, “hard return”) is also used for all kinds
